messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: anomalous telemetry upload detected. External S3 bucket (telemetry-vendor-prod) receiving JSON blobs that include keys named `session_id` with values matching our prod auth token format. Alert ID: TB-9245. Investigating.

alex_oncall: oncall here, ack. investigating source now.

sam_sec: tagging in. if session tokens leaked we need to rotate and revoke sessions ASAP. also need scope of who touched telemetry pipeline.

alex_oncall: grep on telemetry exporter logs shows recent batch job writing redacted and raw payloads to vendor bucket. path: s3://telemetry-vendor-prod/streams/2026-03-17/stream-*.json
```
aws s3 ls s3://telemetry-vendor-prod/streams/2026-03-17/ --recursive
aws s3 cp s3://telemetry-vendor-prod/streams/2026-03-17/stream-20260317-03.json - | jq '.items[0]'
```

platform_sre: confirmed. exporter pod `telemetry-exporter-5d7b` pushing compressed JSON. env shows AWS keys mounted from secret `telemetry-s3-cred`.

alex_oncall: I'm going to rotate the telemetry S3 creds and disable the exporter from writing until we have a fix. @platform_sre can you prepare the secret rotation?

platform_sre: doing now. plan: 1) create new KMS-backed creds, 2) patch k8s secret `telemetry-s3-cred`, 3) restart deployment `telemetry-exporter`, 4) confirm no further uploads. executing step 1.

ops_lead: ping legal & CSM. potential customer token exposure, need timeline, impacted orgs list, and comms plan. @taylor_csm @jordan_legal

taylor_csm: on it — pulling list of orgs with sessions active in the last 24h and any telemetry opt-ins. will DM initial list in 15m.

jordan_legal: need quick blurb for compliance. also log retention for vendor bucket? who has access?

sam_sec: quick notes: 1) treat as potential credential exposure until proven otherwise; 2) revoke affected sessions; 3) rotate any keys that could allow writes to external bucket; 4) collect timeline & hashes of objects uploaded.

alex_oncall: running session revoke for tokens issued after 2026-03-17T02:00Z (suspected window). command:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/admin/sessions/revoke" -d '{"since": "2026-03-17T02:00:00Z"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

platform_sre: secret rotation done: created new IAM key pair, patched secret `telemetry-s3-cred` in `prod` namespace, restarted deployment. monitoring S3 put metrics — no new uploads in last 2m.

devex_maria: noted downstream SDKs that read `session_id` from telemetry payloads — will push hotfix to scrub `session_id` field before serialization. PR in flight: `devex/remove-sessionid-from-telemetry`

sam_sec: collecting copies of uploaded objects for forensic hashing. asking vendor to snapshot and freeze the `streams/2026-03-17` prefix. @platform_sre can you share object list and MD5s when available?

platform_sre: uploaded list: 42 objects. pushing to shared secure bucket `s3://redwood-forensics/incident-TB-9245/` with restricted ACLs. MD5s included.

jordan_legal: initial assessment: likely low customer impact (session tokens, not clear if tied to active auth tokens or short-lived). still need to treat as PII risk. prepping notice templates; will await CSM list.

alex_oncall: status update: mitigation in progress. rotated exporter creds, revoked sessions, vendor freeze requested, forensics copy saved, SDK hotfix in review.

pagerbot: Incident TB-9245 status: TRIAGE -> MITIGATION. Priority: P1 (possible credential exposure). Pager rotated to security oncall.

sam_sec: continuing deeper sweep: check auth logs for token reuse from unknown IPs, and verify if any session_id values match active auth tokens. so far no reuse detected.

taylor_csm: shared initial impacted org list with legal and ops in DM. 3 enterprise customers flagged for immediate outreach if legal advises.

jordan_legal: advise comms for flagged customers: optional early notice + offer rotation assistance. legal ops will finalize wording in 30m.

ops_lead: handoff: alex_oncall -> sam_sec for security postmortem + remediation checklist. alex, keep monitoring for 30m then hand to sec. I'll coordinate post-incident bridge and RCA.

alex_oncall: handing off now. sam_sec, you have the bridge. I'll add notes to incident doc.

sam_sec: taking over. next steps: finalize scope, confirm no active token replay, complete SDK scrub PR, coordinate customer comms with taylor & jordan, prepare postmortem timeline.

alex_oncall: thanks team. closing oncall shift, leaving remediation notes in /incidents/TB-9245.

sam_sec: acknowledged. marking mitigation in progress. will set follow-up incident channel and invite all stakeholders.

pagerbot: last update: 9254321450 — mitigation active, rotation complete, forensic copy stored.

alex_oncall: tl;dr: telemetry exporter leaked `session_id` fields to vendor bucket, rotation & session revocation done, forensics collected, customer outreach plan in progress. moving to security-led postmortem. :lock:
